name: 90292 · Marina Dl Rey, CA
findings: ZIP 90292 (Marina Dl Rey) has 167 nonprofit organizations. 48 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 38 organizations.
Youth organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 90292 (Marina Dl Rey) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 90292 (Marina Dl Rey) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 63% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 60 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.
